conditions.name: Ovarian Cancer

ratingSchedule.note: DC 7627, malignant neoplasms of the gynecological system. This is a system-level malignancy code rather than an ovary-specific diagnostic code.

reviewNotes: Keep ovarian cancer distinct from nonmalignant ovarian identities such as polycystic ovary syndrome. DC 7627 is the applicable gynecological malignancy framework and does not itself establish etiology or nexus.
After active treatment, documented chronic residuals may require evaluation under the appropriate body-system criteria.

conditions.name: Endometrial Cancer
reviewNotes: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 taxonomy identity. No condition-specific VA diagnostic/rating code was assigned or borrowed; retain for qualified catalog/rating review. Malignancy of the endometrium; distinct from ovarian and cervical cancer identities.

conditions.name: Testicular Cancer

ratingSchedule.note: DC 7528, malignant neoplasms of the genitourinary system. This is a system-level malignancy code rather than a testis-specific cancer code.

reviewNotes: Do not collapse active testicular malignancy into testis atrophy or removal criteria under DCs 7523 or 7524. Those criteria may be relevant only to documented residual anatomy after treatment.
DC 7528 supplies rating context only and is not clinical evidence of causation or service connection.

conditions.name: Laryngeal Cancer

ratingSchedule.note: DC 6819, malignant neoplasms of any specified part of the respiratory system exclusive of skin growths; this is a system-level malignancy code rather than a larynx-specific cancer code.

reviewNotes: Keep laryngeal cancer distinct from the existing respiratory-cancer identity, which is scoped to lung, tracheal, and bronchial cancers.

When there is no local recurrence or metastasis after treatment, residuals such as laryngectomy, aphonia, stenosis, swallowing impairment, or other documented functional loss may require separate appropriate diagnostic criteria; do not infer those residuals from the cancer diagnosis alone.
